title: Lapse Relativity in the Named Non-Owner Policy Package-Change Increase Charge
content:
**Lapse relativity — mid-term package change on a Named Non-Owner Policy term.**

1. *Which lapse.* The most recent lapse recorded on the term. Its days are counted from the first lapse day attested on the latest Statement of No Loss signed for the term (the one recorded first when two share the latest document date) through the last lapse day recorded on the term, both included; a lapse with no such statement counts no days.
2. *Window.* The relativity applies only while the lapse window lasts — the 6 whole months that follow that first lapse day, a month being complete on the same day of the following month. The window lasts while fewer than 6 whole months have passed from that first lapse day to the day of the change; on the day 6 whole months are complete it has ended.
3. *Values.* 6 days or more carry 1.12; 3 to 5 days carry 1.06; no lapse, a lapse of 1 or 2 days, or a lapse whose window ended before the day of the change carries none.
4. *Effect.* The relativity multiplies the increase rated premium before the deduction is subtracted, and before the charge is rounded to the cent.

**Combinations (hypothetical; attested first lapse day 25 January).**

| Lapse days | Day of the change | Whole months since 25 January | Relativity |
|---|---|---|---|
| 5 | 24 July | 5 | 1.06 |
| 5 | 25 July | 6 | none |
| 8 | 2 April | 2 | 1.12 |
| 2 | 2 April | 2 | none |
